mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, conditions at Verona Community Park are overcast with a temperature of 80 degrees, though it feels like 87. The moon is currently in a waxing crescent phase.

The Verona Senior Center is looking for new volunteers to help with their programming. Interested individuals should commit to at least two shifts a month. Please note that some positions involve physical tasks like lifting up to 20 pounds, and all volunteers must agree to maintain strict confidentiality regarding participant information.

There is plenty to do this weekend, starting with the Dane County Farmer's Market today. You can also catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company today. Looking ahead, tomorrow features the Cave Carnival at Cave of the Mounds and a Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena.

The Verona Police Department has been busy this week. On Wednesday, an officer stopped a driver for erratic behavior, which resulted in an arrest for a fourth O W I, with a blood draw conducted at the scene.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Turtle sundae. Culver's is open until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by and satisfy your craving.
